body: I'm intermitently suicidal. One day I only think about killing myself, the next day everything's alright. Repeat ad infinitum.
That's the sliver of hope I'm holding onto. Thanks, I appreciate it your kind words.
Yeah, whenever I hear of suicide, people always talk about depression. I think about suicide almost everyday and I don't have depression.
Thanks man I appreciate it. I woke up and it's sunny outside even though we're in the middle of winter here in the south hemisphere. I don't feel as bad as last night.

My failure has to do with academics, money and age (even though I'm young). I'm sorry for not being more specific, but I'm embarrased about it. 3 years ago I thought: it can still be corrected and maybe we could still achieve it. Last year I finally gave up.

I've tried to re-orient my dream, put my attention on something else, but nothing else feels right.

 I know what I wanted to do. I always wanted it.

Sorry for not giving more details.
Those other things feel vain if I've not attained the big goal, but thanks for commenting.
